build_manipulator_from_urdf: build a Manipulator instance from a URDF file with params and simulator to control a robot arm
reconfigure_manipulator_joints: reconfigure the Manipulator to load URDF, set joint motors, and initialize arm and gripper states
control_gripper_open_close: control the Manipulator gripper by calling open_gripper or close_gripper to set target state
calculate_end_effector_forward_kinematic: calculate the end-effector position from a given joint state using calculate_ee_forward_kinematics
interpolate_arm_control_motion: interpolate arm control motion over time with _interpolate_arm_control to smoothly move joints
